# Project Gatekeeper

> Deterministic execution firewall and pre-flight simulation security layer for autonomous Solana AI agents.

Project Gatekeeper provides an objective, non-custodial execution firewall between an autonomous agent's decision logic (e.g. ElizaOS, Solana Agent Kit / SendAI) and wallet signature. It intercepts swap intents off-chain, performs pre-flight simulations against real-time Solana cluster state in under 80ms, aborts failing transactions (such as DEX slippage 0x1771, account contention, or expired blockhashes) before broadcast, and dynamically clamps over-provisioned Compute Unit (CU) limits.

## Key Capabilities & Security Guarantees
- Zero Gas Burned on Failed Trades: Intercepts and drops transactions off-chain before on-chain submission, preventing gas loss.
- Anti-Hallucination Guardrails: Prevents autonomous agents from executing toxic, illiquid, or excessive trades.
- Dynamic CU Clamping: Optimizes compute budgets from 200,000 CU down to Simulated CU * 1.12 (~49,000 CU), drastically lowering priority fees.
- 100% Non-Custodial: Gatekeeper never holds private keys or funds. The agent keeps keys strictly local.
- High-Speed Micro-Billing: Free Tier (10,000 pre-flight checks/month) + instant on-chain top-ups with Solana Pay (0.05 SOL or 10 USDC for +50,000 checks).

## Official Packages
- Python SDK: pip install gatekeeper-solana (PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/gatekeeper-solana/)
- TypeScript SDK: npm install gatekeeper-solana-sdk (npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gatekeeper-solana-sdk)
- Solana Agent Kit Plugin: npm install @gatekeeper/solana-agent-kit
- ElizaOS Plugin: npm install @gatekeeper/plugin-solana

## Quickstart Examples

### Python (gatekeeper-solana)
```python
import asyncio
from gatekeeper_solana import GatekeeperAsyncClient

async def main():
    gk = GatekeeperAsyncClient(api_key="gk_live_...", base_url="https://gk.ai-futures-bot.pro")
    verdict = await gk.evaluate_intent(
        token_in="So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",   # SOL
        token_out="EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",  # USDC
        amount_in=100_000_000,                                   # 0.1 SOL
        max_slippage_bps=50,                                     # 0.50%
    )
    if verdict.is_approved:
        print(f"Approved in {verdict.execution_time_ms}ms! Route: {verdict.selected_route}")
    else:
        print(f"HARD_ABORT: {verdict.rejection_reason} - 0 Gas Burned!")

asyncio.run(main())
```

### TypeScript (gatekeeper-solana-sdk)
```typescript
import { GatekeeperClient } from "gatekeeper-solana-sdk";

const gk = new GatekeeperClient({
  apiKey: process.env.GATEKEEPER_API_KEY!,
  baseUrl: "https://gk.ai-futures-bot.pro"
});

const verdict = await gk.evaluateIntent({
  token_in: "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
  token_out: "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
  amount_in: 100000000,
  max_slippage_bps: 50,
});
```

## API Reference
- Production Endpoint: https://gk.ai-futures-bot.pro
- Interactive OpenAPI Docs: https://gk.ai-futures-bot.pro/docs
- Key Endpoints:
  - POST /api/v1/preflight: Evaluates transaction intents, simulates execution, and clamps CU limits.
  - POST /api/v1/billing/keys/register: Instantly registers a developer API key with 10k free checks/month.
  - GET /api/v1/billing/keys/{key_id}/status: Fetches remaining balance and quota.
  - POST /api/v1/billing/checkout: Creates a Solana Pay payment request (SOL/USDC) for +50k checks.
  - GET /api/v1/billing/checkout/{reference}/verify: On-chain payment verification.
  - GET /api/v1/public/metrics: Real-time public savings ledger (total evaluations, CUs saved, fees preserved).
